```{r setup, include = TRUE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(glue)
library(fs)
library(haven)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
conf <- config::get()
```

```{r}
assessments_with_scans <- read_csv(here("data/raw", "mris_for_converter_analysis.csv"))
clinical_data <- read_csv(here("data/raw", "subjects_study_data.csv"))
brainage_data <- read_csv(here("data/processed", "brainage_for_converter_analysis.csv"))

subjects_with_mri_and_clinical <- assessments_with_scans %>%
    left_join(clinical_data, by = c("cohort", "subject_id", "assessment")) %>%
    left_join(brainage_data %>% select(-date_mri, -group, -scanner), by = c("cohort", "subject_id", "assessment"))
```

missing ages
```{r}
print(glue("Now {subjects_with_mri_and_clinical %>% filter(is.na(age)) %>% nrow()} subjects are missing age"))
```
clean missing onset DateOfOnset
```{r}
print(glue("We have {subjects_with_mri_and_clinical %>% filter(is.na(onset_date)) %>% nrow()} subjects with missing onset_date. Infering from other subject entries."))
# subjects_with_mri_and_clinical <- 
subjects_with_mri_and_clinical <- subjects_with_mri_and_clinical %>%
    group_by(subject_id) %>%
    mutate(
        onset_date = first(onset_date[!is.na(onset_date)])
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
print(glue("Now {subjects_with_mri_and_clinical %>% filter(is.na(onset_date)) %>% nrow()} subjects are missing onset_date"))
```
clean missing sex
```{r}
print(glue("We have {subjects_with_mri_and_clinical %>% filter(is.na(sex)) %>% nrow()} subjects with missing sex. Infering from other subject entries."))
# subjects_with_mri_and_clinical <- 
subjects_with_mri_and_clinical <- subjects_with_mri_and_clinical %>%
    group_by(subject_id) %>%
    mutate(
        sex = first(sex[!is.na(sex)])
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
print(glue("Now {subjects_with_mri_and_clinical %>% filter(is.na(sex)) %>% nrow()} subjects are missing sex"))
```

```{r}
subjects_with_mri_and_clinical_sorted <- subjects_with_mri_and_clinical %>%
    arrange(cohort, subject_id, assessment) %>%
    rename(
        chronological_age = age,
        brain_age = brain.predicted_age,
        brain_age_lower = lower.CI,
        brain_age_upper = upper.CI
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        scanner = as.factor(scanner),
        tiv = gmv + wmv + csf,
        BAG = brain_age - chronological_age,
        group = factor(group, levels = c("HC", "MDD", "CON"), labels = c("HC", "MDD", "CON")),
        remission = factor(remission, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("Non-remitted", "Remitted", "Healthy")),
        recurrence = factor(recurrence, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("Non-recurring", "Recurring", "Healthy"))
    )

write.table(subjects_with_mri_and_clinical_sorted,
            file = here("data/processed/converter_dataset.csv"),
            sep = ",", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE
)
```
